title: Ticket needs another team, user is frustrated
symptom: User is unhappy that their issue must go to a specialist team
user_description: Why can't you just fix it? I've been waiting two days and now you're telling me it's going to another team? Nobody tells me anything!

options.text: Promise it will definitely be fixed today
options.why: You cannot control the other team's work. A broken promise makes her trust IT even less.

options.text: Explain honestly why it needs a specialist team, give her the ticket number and a realistic time for the next update, then follow up
options.why: Honesty and clear expectations reduce frustration. Following up shows the ticket has not been forgotten.

options.text: Tell her the other team is slow and it is not your fault
options.why: Blaming colleagues looks unprofessional and does not help her.

options.text: Close the ticket since it is not your team's job
options.why: The user still has the problem. Escalating means handing over properly, not walking away.

hints: What does she want most: a fix, or to know what is happening?
Can you promise what another team will do?
How can you show her the ticket has not been forgotten?
real_world_tip: When you escalate, write a clear summary in the ticket so the user never has to explain the problem again to the next team.
